profile_text.body:
OpusClip describes itself as the #1 AI video clipping and editing tool. According to its website, the product turns long videos into high-quality viral clips and publishes them to all social platforms in one click, and the company says it helps 20M+ creators create and grow faster. OpusClip is categorized as a video generation and editing product focused on video repurposing. The company was founded in 2022 and is headquartered in Palo Alto.

The site describes ClipAnything as the only AI clipping model that turns any genre, including vlogs, gaming, sports, interviews, and explainer videos, into viral clips in 1 click. It also describes an AI reframe model that resizes any video for any platform and keeps moving subjects centered with AI object tracking, with a manual tracking option for instructing the AI what to follow. OpusClip says it uses big data to analyze video content against social and marketing trends from major platforms, then selects highlighting moments, rearranges them into a short, and adds dynamic captions, AI-relayout, and transitions, ending with a call-to-action. The site says ClipAnything can handle talking-head videos, vlogs, sports, TV shows, and videos with little or no dialogue, and supports natural language prompts to clip a specific moment. A testimonial on the site from Jason Lemkin states: "The only AI tool that I've found helpful so far is OpusClip. It can do something that I don't have time to do. I'm a super fan."
